title: bank of england / gilt repo / market structure | Regulatory Guidance | Enhancing the resilience of the gilt repo market – discussio...
summary: The Bank of England has published a feedback statement summarizing industry responses to its September 2025 discussion paper on gilt repo market resilience. The Bank is considering reforms including greater central clearing and minimum haircuts on non-centrally cleared transactions. While respondents supported the objective of enhanced resilience, they raised concerns about access barriers, operational constraints, and potential liquidity impacts of mandatory measures. The Bank will continue exploring these reforms in collaboration with the FCA, HM Treasury, and the DMO.
